Design and implement autonomous agent architectures that handle multi-step reasoning, tool use, memory, and planning in production security workflows
Build reliable agent loops with proper error handling, retry logic, guardrails, and human-inthe-loop approval gates for high-risk actions
Develop dynamic tool-calling pipelines where agents select, configure, and orchestrate external security tools based on contextual analysis
Engineer prompt chains and agent reasoning strategies across multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Anthropic Claude) with model-agnostic abstractions
Build and maintain the context layer that gives agents awareness of users, assets, past incidents, typical behavior, and environmental state
Design evaluation frameworks to measure agent reliability, accuracy, and safety — especially for high-stakes actions like exploit execution or incident response recommendations
Collaborate with security engineers to translate offensive and defensive domain expertise into agent behavior, tool profiles, and decision logic
Optimize for latency, cost, and token efficiency in production agent workloads
Support on-premise deployments using self-hosted open-source models (DeepSeek, Llama) for air-gapped enterprise customers

Experience with tool-calling / function-calling patterns, including dynamic tool selection and chaining

Experience integrating with multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and managing model-agnostic abstractions

Background in cybersecurity — offensive (pentesting, vulnerability assessment, red teaming) or defensive (SOC operations, SIEM, detection engineering, incident response)

Work with a team that understands both security and AI deeply

title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
description:
Role Mission and General Characteristics
Software Development Engineer in Test  performs as a technical expert in the design, development and maintenance of automated testing solutions to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our products
The SDET combines strong software development expertise with quality engineering practices and requires working closely with Developers, Product Managers/PMO, DevOps engineers, and QA teams.
Role Main activities
Contribute to the validation-test plans, perform measurements and functional tests on prototypes, assuring full coverage of all requirements;
Ensure technical documentation are kept up to date and stored in accordance with departmental procedures;
Embrace innovation culture of our Company, contributing to generate invention disclosures and to scout/evaluate novel and differentiating technologies;
Participate in the maintenance of existing products, with the aim also to solve problems arisen from field or production.
Job Details & Specifications
Design, develop and maintain automated test infrastructure/frameworks that improve productivity and quality. Improve test coverage through automation of functional, integration, regression and end-to-end test.
Leverage solid software development experience to design scalable, maintainable, and efficient test solutions, applying software engineering best practices throughout the test automation lifecycle.
Demonstrate independent thinking and problem-solving skills by proactively identifying quality risks, proposing solutions, and driving improvements with minimal supervision.
Analyze business and technical requirements to define comprehensive test strategies. Ensure software and the product functionalities meet quality, reliability, usability and performance requirements.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipeline. Improve release readiness through quality gates and automated validation processes.
Collaborate in code reviews and inspections to ensure the testability of code.
Create and maintain documentation related to automated test cases, test plans, and test results to support knowledge sharing and transparency
requirements:
Technical Skills
Strong understanding of software development lifecyle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies
Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Java, Python or TypeScript
Experience in test automation frameworks such as PlayWright, RobotFramework
Experience of Linux, Git, JFrog and Jenkins
Experience with API testing, integration testing, and business logic validation
Experience using AI-assisted coding and testing tools
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: Ability to identify and troubleshoot complex technical issues
Knowledge of industrial protocols such as ProfiNET, Ethernet/IP, etc.,
Soft Skills
Planning and time management
Experience in managing a small team (3-5 people) is a big plus
Excellent communication skills:
the ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional environment and
team working
Demonstrates a proactive approach to exploring emerging technologies and driving innovation in product quality
.
benefits:

Be proud to see your own developed products sold all over the world
Strong knowledge and skills improvement through practical training and technical experience
Career promotion with proven capabilities
Opportunity for overseas training (US, Europe, etc.)

title: Senior Platform Engineer (Linux, K8S, Git, CI/CD)
description:
1. MỤC ĐÍCH CÔNG VIỆC
Thiết kế, xây dựng, vận hành và liên tục cải tiến nền tảng Kubernetes/container cùng các dịch vụ kỹ thuật dùng chung (CI/CD, GitOps, IaC/Automation) phục vụ hệ thống core bảo hiểm, ứng dụng nội bộ và các nền tảng của MB Life.
Giữ vai trò dẫn dắt kỹ thuật (acting technical lead) của mảng Platform: định hướng chuẩn kỹ thuật, phân công – review công việc và kèm cặp kỹ sư Platform cấp Junior/Mid.
Nâng cao độ tin cậy, bảo mật và khả năng kiểm soát thay đổi của nền tảng; giảm tác vụ thủ công lặp lại (toil), bảo đảm khả năng truy vết và tuân thủ quy định của MB Life.
2.  NHIỆM VỤ VÀ TRÁCH NHIỆM
Trách nhiệm chuyên môn:
A. Kubernetes & Cloud Platform (trọng tâm)
Thiết kế, triển khai, quản trị vòng đời và vận hành các cụm Kubernetes production/non-production: cấu hình, nâng cấp, mở rộng node, bảo trì và phương án rollback.
Phân tích, xử lý sự cố Kubernetes
Chuẩn hóa Helm chart, manifests, registry, resource request/limit, autoscaling và các thành phần platform dùng chung; theo dõi khả năng mở rộng, hiệu năng và capacity.
B. CI/CD, GitOps & Release Safety
Xây dựng, vận hành và cải tiến năng lực CI/CD dùng chung (GitLab CI/Jenkins hoặc tương đương), runners/agents và bộ pipeline template có thể tái sử dụng.
Triển khai GitOps (Argo CD/Flux hoặc tương đương), quản lý cấu hình khai báo theo Git, kiểm soát drift, review, approval, traceability và rollback.
Phối hợp cùng Development/DevOps và ANTT tích hợp kiểm thử, kiểm tra dependency, SAST/SCA, image scan, quản lý artifacts/secrets trong quy trình phát hành; hỗ trợ chiến lược rollout/canary/blue-green khi phù hợp.
Chuẩn hóa quy trình triển khai lên nền tảng; trách nhiệm về mã nguồn, nghiệp vụ và chất lượng ứng dụng thuộc đội phát triển/ứng dụng theo phân công.
C. Infrastructure as Code & Automation
Thiết kế, phát triển và duy trì module/playbook/script bằng Terraform, Ansible, Python, Bash hoặc công cụ tương đương để cấp phát, cấu hình và vận hành platform một cách có thể lặp lại.
Quản lý mã IaC/Automation bằng Git; áp dụng code review, lint/test, quản lý state và secrets an toàn, kiểm soát thay đổi và lưu dấu vết thực thi.
Nhận diện toil, ưu tiên tự động hóa các yêu cầu lặp lại; xây dựng công cụ hoặc workflow có tài liệu, có kiểm tra lỗi và có khả năng tái sử dụng cho nhiều nhóm.
D. Reliability, Observability & Incident Management
Xây dựng, tích hợp giám sát metrics, logs và traces khi phù hợp cho Kubernetes, CI/CD, GitOps và các dịch vụ platform; phát triển dashboard, cảnh báo có thể hành động và giảm alert noise.
Đề xuất SLI/SLO phù hợp từng dịch vụ nền tảng sau khi thống nhất đối tượng sử dụng, nguồn đo và trách nhiệm vận hành; theo dõi xu hướng capacity, availability và hiệu năng.
Tham gia on-call theo lịch; chủ trì xử lý incident trong phạm vi platform, thực hiện RCA/blameless postmortem, cập nhật runbook và theo dõi hành động phòng ngừa.
Phối hợp đội Infrastructure/Backup và Application để kiểm chứng yêu cầu HA, backup/restore, DR, RTO/RPO liên quan tới workloads và dịch vụ nền tảng.
E. Security, Compliance & Cross-team Delivery
Phối hợp ANTT áp dụng hardening, least privilege, quản lý secrets, image security, runtime guardrails, audit logging và cung cấp log/sự kiện cho SIEM theo chính sách.
Thực hiện thay đổi có đánh giá rủi ro, kiểm thử, phương án rollback và bằng chứng; tuân thủ quy trình phê duyệt hiện hành, đồng thời đề xuất chuẩn hóa/automation cho standard changes đủ điều kiện.
Phối hợp với Infrastructure/Network/Storage/Backup, DevOps/Development, Application, ANTT và Vendor; làm rõ ownership, dependencies và escalation khi triển khai hoặc xử lý sự cố.
Tư vấn yêu cầu phi chức năng và production readiness cho dịch vụ sử dụng platform; viết tài liệu kiến trúc, SOP/runbook và tham gia PoC khi được giao.
F. Technical Leadership | Dẫn dắt kỹ thuật
Xây dựng và duy trì chuẩn kỹ thuật của mảng Platform (cấu hình cluster, Helm chart, pipeline template, quy ước IaC, runbook); review thay đổi/merge request của kỹ sư khác trước khi áp dụng lên Production.
Lập kế hoạch kỹ thuật, chia nhỏ hạng mục và phân công công việc cho kỹ sư Platform Junior/Mid; theo dõi tiến độ, chất lượng và báo cáo Trưởng phòng.
Tham mưu Trưởng phòng về lộ trình phát triển nền tảng, bao gồm các năng lực mở rộng giai đoạn sau (self-service/IDP, AI hỗ trợ vận hành) khi nền tảng lõi đã ổn định.
Trách nhiệm chung
Tuân thủ chính sách, quy định và chuẩn an toàn thông tin của Công ty; bảo mật thông tin và cung cấp bằng chứng kiểm toán theo phạm vi trách nhiệm.
Chủ động phối hợp các bộ phận liên quan; thực hiện công việc khác phù hợp chức năng vị trí theo phân công của lãnh đạo.
requirements:
Trình độ & kinh nghiệm
Tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành CNTT, Khoa học máy tính, Điện tử viễn thông hoặc tương đương theo tiêu chuẩn tuyển dụng của Công ty; đọc hiểu tốt tài liệu kỹ thuật tiếng Anh, giao tiếp với hãng/đối tác qua email, ticket.
Tối thiểu 4 năm kinh nghiệm trong Infrastructure, DevOps, SRE hoặc Platform Engineering; trong đó tối thiểu 2 năm trực tiếp triển khai/vận hành Kubernetes production.
Có kinh nghiệm thực tế với thay đổi/nâng cấp nền tảng, phân tích sự cố production và triển khai automation có thể kiểm chứng qua dự án, sản phẩm hoặc tình huống kỹ thuật.
Đã từng dẫn dắt kỹ thuật một hạng mục/dự án hoặc hướng dẫn
Kiến thức và năng lực bắt buộc (must-have)
Linux vững; hiểu TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, HTTP/HTTPS, load balancing, firewall và các nguyên tắc network/storage phục vụ Kubernetes.

title: Senior Technical Product Owner (Savings)
description:
As a
Senior Product Owner - Savings Products
at Zalopay, you will take end-to-end ownership of our strategic
Savings product portfolio
- one of the most critical growth pillars and financial backbones of the entire Zalopay ecosystem.
Your portfolio encompasses two strategic pillars:
"Số dư sinh lời" (Money Market Fund):
A mission-critical, high-concurrency accumulation and yield engine deeply embedded across the Zalopay ecosystem. As Zalopay’s user base expands, the adoption and active usage of Số dư sinh lời grow organically at immense scale, creating high-concurrency traffic that demands exceptional system resilience, real-time partner synchronization, robust fund flows, and operational integrity.
"Gửi Tiết kiệm" (Fixed Deposit):
A scalable open-banking savings platform connecting Zalopay users with multiple leading commercial and digital banking partners simultaneously.
In this role, you will take direct, primary ownership of
"Số dư sinh lời" -
governing its complex financial architecture, partner synchronization, and high-scale operational resilience - while steering the broader savings portfolio strategy, overseeing multi-bank integrations for
"Gửi Tiết kiệm"
, and mentoring Junior PO(s) to ensure exceptional delivery quality for millions of Vietnamese users.
Key Responsibilities
1. Primary Ownership: "Số dư sinh lời" (Money Market Fund)
Serve as the principal product owner for Số dư sinh lời, driving its long-term roadmap, user adoption, and retention aligned with Zalopay’s ecosystem growth.
Deeply govern system architecture and high-throughput transaction flows: real-time balance and yield synchronization with financial partners, transactional state machines, automated fund flows, and ledger consistency under intense peak traffic.
Collaborate closely with Engineering, System Architects, Operations, and Finance & Accounting to establish robust reconciliation, settlement cycles, and high-availability failover mechanisms.
2. Strategic Steering: "Gửi Tiết kiệm" (Fixed Deposit) & Multi-Bank Platform
Oversee the strategic expansion of our Gửi Tiết kiệm platform as we onboard multiple commercial and digital banking partners concurrently.
Standardize open-banking API integration frameworks, onboarding blueprints, and data exchange protocols to accelerate partner integration velocity while ensuring bank-grade security.
Serve as the senior technical-commercial counterpart for banking partners: negotiate business requirements (BRD), core-banking constraints, SLAs, and dispute-resolution workflows.
3. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Governance
Ensure all products and integration models within the Savings portfolio strictly adhere to State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) regulations, payment intermediary laws, consumer protection standards, and eKYC requirements.
Work closely with Legal, Compliance, and Risk teams to assess regulatory impacts, safeguard user assets, and proactively mitigate operational and systemic risks.
4. Delivery Excellence & Junior PO Mentorship
Act as a player-coach: drive deep technical and functional design for your primary product (Số dư sinh lời) while providing direct guidance, coaching, and review for
Junior PO(s)
executing on multi-bank Gửi Tiết kiệm streams.
Establish product quality standards, edge-case analysis frameworks, and acceptance criteria across squads to ensure flawless delivery and high-quality releases.
Lead agile ceremonies and cross-functional alignment across Engineering, QA, Design, Risk, Legal, Operations, and Business teams.
5. User-Centric Experience & Data-Driven Growth
Apply Design Thinking to translate complex financial concepts and banking constraints into transparent, intuitive, and reassuring user journeys that foster long-term financial trust.
Define and analyze key product metrics (AUM, conversion funnels, drop-offs, operational latency) to uncover actionable insights and iteratively optimize user experiences.

Exceptional ability to conceptualize complex, multi-layered system architectures, transaction state machines, and partner fund flows with an uncompromising focus on scalability, fault tolerance, and financial reconciliation.

Relentless in dissecting edge cases, anticipating operational failure modes, and constructively challenging constraints from both internal squads and external financial/banking partners.

Deep appreciation for financial regulations, legal boundaries, and risk governance; ability to design compliant yet user-friendly product mechanisms.

Stakeholder & Multi-Partner Project Management:
Proven track record of managing complex external dependencies (banks, financial institutions) and orchestrating cross-functional teams (Tech, QA, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Finance).

of Product Management / Product Owner experience in

guiding, coaching, or mentoring Junior POs

Think Beyond, Deliver Excellence, Succeed Together

MB là một trong những ngân hàng hệ sinh thái Số dẫn đầu tại Việt Nam, với định hướng trở thành “Doanh nghiệp số, Tập đoàn tài chính dẫn đầu”, công nghệ tại MB hiện được thúc đẩy dựa trên 5 trụ cột cốt lõi: công nghệ mới, tự động hóa, dữ liệu, AI và con người. Tính đến năm 2026, ngân hàng đang được phục vụ gần 40 triệu khách hàng, xử lý hơn 12,4 tỷ giao dịch trên kênh Số. Hiện tại, chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm  cơ hội hợp tác cùng các ứng viên AI Engineer, Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer có năng lực chuyên môn sâu để gia nhập và phát triển các sản phẩm Số phục vụ quy mô người dùng lớn. Đây sẽ là cơ hội để Bạn thực hiện khát vọng phát triển những nền tảng ứng dụng AI tiên tiến cùng tiềm năng tạo ảnh hướng lớn đến cộng đồng cùng MB.
Mô tả công việc:
Nhân sự AI tại MB sẽ tham gia các dự án khác nhau tùy theo thế mạnh chuyên môn và nhu cầu phát triển năng lực của bản thân, có thể kể đến các mảng công việc sau:
1. Thiết kế và triển khai các giải pháp AI/ML toàn diện (end-to-end), như LLM, pipeline RAG, semantic search), AI Agent, chatbot, fraud detection.
2. Thiết kế và triển khai các giải pháp AI/ML trong lĩnh vực Thị giác máy tính (Computer Vision), bao gồm eKYC, OCR, segmentation, classification, camera AI.
3. Coding, test metrics, service và unit test theo mô hình DevOps, MLOps
4. Tích hợp và tối ưu hóa quy trình làm việc AI bằng các framework và công cụ như LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face,...
5. Nghiên cứu và áp dụng các nghiên cứu mới ( SOTA) như Reinforcement Learning, Self-Supervised Learning và Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning...
Với nhóm ứng viên là sinh viên tài năng và fresher: yêu cầu tham gia các chương trình đào tạo và dự án mới tại MB để để phát triển lên các vị trí Kỹ sư cấp cao tại MB trong tương lai gần
requirements:
Học vấn:
Tốt nghiệp Đại học trở lên các chuyên ngành: Công nghệ thông tin, Khoa học máy tính, Kỹ thuật phần mềm, Hệ thống thông tin, Điện tử Viễn thông, Trí tuệ nhân tạo (AI), Khoa học dữ liệu hoặc các ngành liên quan.
Kiến thức và kỹ năng chuyên môn
:
Ứng viên cần có nển tảng chuyên môn tốt về một hoặc nhiều mảng sau:
1. Lập trình:
- Thành thạo một trong các ngôn ngữ: Python, C/C++.
- Có kinh nghiệm phát triển Backend Service/Microservices với các framework như FastAPI, Flask hoặc Django.
2. Machine Learning & Deep Learning
- Có kinh nghiệm sử dụng ít nhất 01 framework AI/ML phổ biến như: PyTorch, TensorFlow,...
- Nắm vững các mô hình và thuật toán Machine Learning/Deep Learning như: Supervised Learning, Reinforcement Learning; CNN, Transformer...
- Có kinh nghiệm về tối ưu mô hình: Knowledge Distillation, Model Pruning, Model Quantization, Inference Optimization...
3. AI Applications
Có kinh nghiệm nghiên cứu hoặc triển khai các bài toán về:
+  Computer Vision (CV), Image Processing, Video Analytics, eKYC, Document AI.
+ Natural Language Processing (NLP)
+ Speech/Audio Processing.
+ Fraud Detection
4. MLOps & AI Deployment
Có kinh nghiệm sử dụng:  Git, Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, Kubeflow, TensorFlow Serving, Triton Inference Server

title: Senior QC Engineer
description:
Job Summary
Ensure the overall quality of multi-domain AI projects and products, including Agentic Solutions, Orchestrators, and Infrastructure, by designing, executing, and reporting on functional, performance, and user experience testing. Collaborate closely with development, AI/ML, UX/UI, and operations teams to ensure product reliability, accuracy, and quality.
Key Responsibilities
1. Test Design and Execution
Design test scenarios, prepare test data, and execute test cases for various product features and project requirements.
Perform cross-platform, cross-browser, and multilingual testing for multi-domain AI projects.
Participate in requirements analysis and contribute to test planning and test strategy development.
2. LLM and AI Quality Evaluation
Evaluate the quality and performance of LLM-based and AI-powered solutions, including Chatbots, Virtual Assistants (VAs), Callbots, and Voice Recording systems.
Assess LLM accuracy, intent recognition, context management, and multi-turn conversation handling.
Identify and document logical errors, unnatural responses, inaccurate outputs, and potentially harmful AI-generated responses.
3. Bug Analysis and Debugging
Analyze, debug, and categorize defects using system logs, technical knowledge, and troubleshooting experience.
Interact with backend systems to inspect logs, trace processing workflows, and validate JSON outputs and other data structures.
4. Test Automation
Develop or recommend automated testing frameworks and tools for API and UI/UX testing.
Identify opportunities to improve test efficiency, coverage, and repeatability through automation.
5. Defect Management and Quality Reporting
Log and track defects using tools such as Jira, Excel, or TestRail, and monitor resolution progress.
Prepare periodic quality reports and analyze defect trends to identify risks and recommend improvements.
Work with relevant teams to ensure issues are resolved effectively and product quality is continuously improved.
requirements:
Must-have
Bachelor's degree or college diploma in Information Technology or a related field.
At least 3–5 years of experience in software, system, or mobile application testing.
Proficiency in test case design, test planning, test reporting, software testing processes, and defect management.
Experience in AI, voice assistant, or multi-agent system testing is a strong advantage.
Knowledge of API testing, performance testing (latency and accuracy), and multilingual conversational testing is a plus.
Strong logical and strategic thinking, attention to detail, and a strong sense of responsibility for product quality.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience testing AI products integrated with web applications, SDKs, and backend systems.
Understanding of LLMs, NLP, Orchestrators, Knowledge Bases, and RAG.
Familiarity with test automation tools such as Appium and Selenium, as well as tools for API testing and log analysis, such as Postman and TestRail.
Hands-on experience with automation tools (Selenium, Playwright, Appium, etc.) and API testing tools (Postman, REST Assured, JMeter, etc.).
Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Soft Skills
Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.
System-oriented thinking with a strong user-centric mindset.
Ability to read and understand technical documentation in both English and Vietnamese.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Detail-oriented, quick to learn, and able to grasp new information rapidly.
Benefits
Competitive salary and benefits in accordance with company policies.
A professional and dynamic working environment with opportunities to participate in large-scale projects.
Opportunities for professional training and skill development.

title: IoT Security Researcher- Up to 100M
description:
Nghiên cứu bảo mật các thiết bị IoT/Embedded, bao gồm camera, router, gateway, smart device, industrial/consumer IoT.
Phân tích firmware, filesystem, bootloader, embedded OS và network services.
Reverse engineering binary trên các kiến trúc ARM, MIPS, x86 hoặc các kiến trúc embedded khác.
Phân tích các giao thức giao tiếp như UART, SPI, I2C, JTAG, BLE, Zigbee, MQTT, Wi-Fi và các giao thức proprietary.
Tìm kiếm lỗ hổng, xây dựng PoC và đánh giá khả năng khai thác trên thiết bị thực tế.
Thực hiện hardware hacking, firmware extraction, debugging và emulation khi cần.
Xây dựng tool/script hỗ trợ firmware analysis, fuzzing và vulnerability discovery.
Nghiên cứu attack surface mới trên các hệ sinh thái IoT và đề xuất công nghệ/sản phẩm bảo mật.
requirements:
Có kiến thức về Linux/Embedded Linux, networking và hệ thống nhúng.
Có từ 3 năm kinh nghiệm trở lên ở vị trí tương đương
Có khả năng lập trình C/C++ và Python.
Có kinh nghiệm reverse engineering bằng IDA Pro, Ghidra, Binary Ninja hoặc công cụ tương đương.
Hiểu kiến trúc CPU, memory, assembly và các dạng memory corruption cơ bản.
Có khả năng sử dụng Linux tốt.
ĐIỂM CỘNG
Kinh nghiệm với UART/JTAG/SPI/I2C, logic analyzer hoặc hardware debugger.
Kinh nghiệm firmware emulation với QEMU.
Kinh nghiệm với OpenWrt, BusyBox, RTOS.
Có CVE hoặc từng nghiên cứu lỗ hổng trên router/camera/IoT device.
Kinh nghiệm fuzzing network protocol hoặc embedded software.
YÊU CẦU CHUNG ĐỐI VỚI SECURITY RESEARCHER
Có tư duy research-oriented, chủ động đào sâu nguyên lý thay vì chỉ sử dụng công cụ có sẵn.
Có khả năng tự nghiên cứu một chủ đề mới, xây dựng môi trường thử nghiệm và kiểm chứng giả thuyết.
Có khả năng viết PoC/tool/script phục vụ nghiên cứu.
Đọc hiểu tốt tài liệu kỹ thuật tiếng Anh.
Có khả năng viết báo cáo và trình bày kết quả nghiên cứu.
Ưu tiên ứng viên có CVE, paper, blog kỹ thuật, GitHub project, CTF achievement hoặc vulnerability disclosure.
Có tinh thần chia sẻ kiến thức và phối hợp cùng các researcher thuộc nhiều domain khác nhau.
Tuân thủ nguyên tắc Responsible Disclosure, quy định pháp luật và phạm vi nghiên cứu được phê duyệt.

description:

Con Cung is the biggest omni-channel company for mom & baby with 600 retail stores in Vietnam in 2021 and plan to have 1,000 stores by 2023 with 1 billion USD revenue. Con Cung's annual growth rate is more than 70%. With the vision of providing good quality products for children, Con Cung is strongly investing into Product Research and Development in order to manufacture and provide products that are suitable to the local market in terms of pricing and quality. We also invest into technology in order to manage the network and online channel efficiently.
Con Cung Corporation also develops in-house cutting-edge automation and intelligence technologies. We are seeking for young, smart & dynamic talents to grow your career together with us.
Job Description
The company is seeking a
SecOps Engineer
to design, implement, and operate its core security infrastructure and network security, with particular emphasis on securing and hardening the Kubernetes/container platform. This role is both hands-on and strategic: building secure-by-design infrastructure from the ground up before expanding into SOC/DFIR capability as the security baseline matures. The engineer will combine deep systems/platform expertise with security engineering judgment to close foundational gaps.
Key Responsibilities
1.  Security Architecture & Infrastructure
Design and implement Identity & Access Management (IAM/SSO) architecture and Single Sign-On integration across internal applications.
Design and implement Privileged Access Management (PAM) and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) / identity-aware proxy solutions.
Design and implement network security architecture, including segmentation, firewalls, VPN, and secure remote access.
Build infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible) and version-controlled configuration where applicable.
2.  Platform & Container Security
Support the hardening of the company's Kubernetes platform: RBAC design, network policy, workload security baseline, secrets management.
Contribute to the rollout of Policy-as-Code (e.g., Kyverno, OPA) for cluster governance.
Collaborate with the current Cluster Admin to reduce single-point-of-failure risk and support knowledge transfer / documentation.
3.  SOC Development & Operations
Support the design, implementation, and day-to-day operation of the company's SOC capabilities (SIEM, EDR, log management, monitoring pipelines).
Contribute to detection rule and alert logic development as SOC capability is built out.
4. Threat Detection, Response & DFIR
Participate in security event investigation, containment, and remediation activities.
Contribute to DFIR playbooks, escalation paths, and evidence-handling procedures.
5.  Continuous Improvement & Collaboration
Assist in tabletop exercises and simulations to validate incident response readiness.
Collaborate with IT, InfraOps, AppSec, and Red Team functions to close security gaps.
Document architecture decisions, runbooks, and lessons learned.
Contribute to security policies, standards, and compliance initiatives (ISO 27001, etc.) incollaboration with the GRC team.
requirements:

2-3+ years of experience in security engineering, infrastructure/platform engineering, SRE, or DevSecOps.
Hands-on production experience operating Kubernetes — RBAC design and troubleshooting, network policy, workload/container security fundamentals.
Practical experience designing or implementing at least one of: IAM/SSO (e.g., Keycloak, Okta, Azure AD), PAM, ZTNA / identity-aware proxy, or network security architecture (firewall, segmentation, VPN).
Strong Linux system administration and scripting/automation skills (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar).
Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code and/or GitOps concepts (Terraform, Ansible, ArgoCD/Flux, or equivalent).
A proactive attitude & the ability to think outside of the box.
Works in an organized, structured manner; can-do attitude, gets things done.
Excellent communication skills with diverse audiences.
Strong critical thinking and analytical skills.

Experience with SIEM platforms (ELK Stack, Wazuh, Splunk, Graylog) or EDR tools.
Foundation skills in log analysis, network traffic analysis, or malware analysis.
Solid understanding of security frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks).
Foundation knowledge in AI integration for security operations.
English communication.
Relevant certifications: CKA/CKS, Security+, GCIA, GCIH, or equivalent.

title: Product Owner
company: CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN ĐẦU TƯ PHÁT TRIỂN SKY CORPORATION
description:
BettaMax
is Sky Corporation's commerce platform
for cross-border dropshipping and print-on-demand (POD) sellers: think Shopify, but purpose-built for them. We are now turning BettaMax into an AI-native platform, where an AI agent works next to the seller in every part of the store
The platform has grown into several large modules, each a product in its own right. So instead of one PO for everything, we are hiring several Product Owners, each owning 1–2 modules end-to-end: their users, roadmap and results
We are currently looking for qualified candidates to join our team with the following details:
Product Strategy & Roadmap
Own the vision, roadmap and quarterly goals of your module, aligned with the overall BettaMax roadmap
Talk to sellers every week. Turn their problems, usage data and competitor moves into clear priorities
Backlog & Delivery
Own and prioritize the module backlog. Define the problem, scope and acceptance criteria; the BA turns them into detailed stories
Make the trade-offs on scope, quality and timing with engineers, designers and QC, and accept or reject delivered work
Coordination & Performance
Decide, with the AI Agent PO, what the AI agent should do for sellers in your module: which tasks it takes over, and where the seller reviews and approves
Coordinate with the other module POs where modules meet (e.g. Online Store ↔ Payment)
Set the module's KPIs, track them after every release, and report progress and risks to leadership.
requirements:
Must have
Min 3 years as a Product Owner or Product Manager on a software product, with at least 1 year in or close to the domain of the module you apply for
Features you shipped end-to-end, and the results you can show for them: metrics, not just releases
Hands-on eCommerce sense: you have set up and run a store on Shopify or a similar platform, or worked closely with online sellers
Comfort with technical discussion: APIs, integrations, data flows. You can read API docs and write precise acceptance criteria
Data-driven: you define KPIs and read the numbers yourself
You use AI tools in your daily work and can spot where an AI agent could do a task for the seller
Good written English for specs and competitor research; clear communication with the team in Vietnamese
Age: Preferred candidates born in 1991–1999
Nice to have
Experience with cross-border eCommerce, dropshipping or print-on-demand, or at a SaaS serving merchants
You have run your own online store or dropshipping business
Experience designing AI or agent features (chat assistants, automation, LLM-based tools)
SQL or analytics tools (GA4, Mixpanel, Metabase); Jira, Confluence, Figma.
benefits:
Real ownership, clear scope: your module, your roadmap, your KPIs. No spreading thin across the whole platform
Focus on product decisions: a BA details the user stories and a Scrum Master runs the ceremonies, so your time goes to sellers, data and priorities
Hard, global problems: our sellers sell to buyers worldwide; your module touches real cross-border money, orders and stores every day
Build with AI from day one: you shape how an AI agent changes the way sellers run their stores, not just add features to old screens
Compensation & perks
Salary: Up to 50 million VND/month; annual salary review and 13th-month bonus
Social and health insurance, annual health check-up, 12 days of annual leave, company-sponsored domestic and international trips
Holiday, birthday and seniority bonuses; training courses, workshops and mentoring programs
Sports clubs (football, badminton, and more); pantry with complimentary coffee, tea and soft drinks.

title: Senior IT Business Analyst
description:
JOB PURPOSE
Be the business analyst for two US product teams: a reporting product for component manufacturing customers and a design software product for residential customers.
Turn business requests and planned features into clear, prioritized work that is ready for development
, so that the development teams deliver the right work in the right order.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Requirements management and business analysis
Own the intake and backlog of business requests and planned features: log, clarify, group similar items and keep the status current.
Analyze the business need, rules, data and workflow behind each request, break features down and find dependencies.
Write clear user stories with acceptance criteria and mock-ups, and get stakeholder agreement before development starts.
Stakeholder collaboration and business value
Lead regular priority reviews with business stakeholders and agree the next work to deliver based on business value.
Give regular status updates and set clear expectations on timing.
Use data and feedback to support priorities and to track delivery progress.
Balance priorities across the two product teams.
Solution validation and delivery support
Walk the development team through requirements, answer their questions and control changes to agreed requirements.
Validate delivered work against acceptance criteria with QA engineers and stakeholders, and turn feedback into follow-up work.
Keep requirements, release notes and process documentation current.
AI-enabled delivery and process improvement
Use approved AI tools to analyze inputs and to draft and check requirements. Check and correct AI output, and follow company data policies.
Improve the intake process, templates and definition of ready.
Perform other tasks as assigned by Line Manager.
requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration or a related field.
5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, IT Business Analyst or Product Owner on software, reporting or data products, including work for two or more teams at the same time.
2+ years of working directly with senior business stakeholders in the US or other international markets.
Proven skills in requirements management and business analysis: elicitation, process modeling, rapid prototyping, user stories and acceptance criteria generation
Good understanding of reports and data. Basic SQL or experience with BI and reporting tools is a plus.
Strong stakeholder management and facilitation, including agreeing priorities between competing requests.
Practical use of AI tools in business analysis work.
Exceptional communication skills in English, both written and verbal (TOEIC 800 or equivalent).
Experience working with distributed teams across time zones, and willing to join some meetings in the during evening time.
Domain knowledge of the building, construction, or manufacturing industry is a plus.
Familiarity with JIRA and Confluence is a plus
Business analysis or product certification (for example, IIBA ECBA or CCBA, or PSPO I) is a plus.
benefits:
Attractive salary with 100% SHUI applied salary during probation
13th month salary, Performance Bonus, Salary review annually
Opportunity to be on site in the USA
Chance to collaborate and work with our global stakeholders
We provide employee training & development to enhance skills set and competencies
Premium health care program for you + one of your beloved ones, Annual medical check-up
14 vacation days and Christmas Day (25/12) per year
Benefits for special holidays (Birthday, Marriage, Women’s Day, Tet Holidays, Mid-Autumn, Newborn babies, International Children ‘s Day…)
Social Activities, Sports Clubs, Team-building events, Year-End party are carried out on a regular basis
Young, friendly, quality and result oriented working environment under team-work spirit
Compliance fully to Vietnam Labor Code

title: Senior Business Analyst (Agile/ Scrum)
description:
1. Requirement Discovery & Analysis
Work with Product Owner, Market Development, and customers to understand business problems, use cases, operating conditions, and expected outcomes.
Elicit, clarify, and document requirements; analyze current and target workflows; identify gaps, risks, and impact on robot behavior and system integration.
Manage assumptions, dependencies, constraints, and known limitations.
2. Requirement Specification for Development
Write user stories, use cases, workflows, and functional/non-functional requirements with clear, measurable acceptance criteria.
Specify API/system integration, data flows, state transitions, error handling, fallback behavior, and edge cases (e.g., network loss, sensor failure, incorrect AI response).
Define evaluation criteria for AI features (e.g., accuracy, latency, behavior boundaries) together with Tech Leads.
3. Day-to-day Collaboration with the Development Team
Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and sprint reviews; keep stories ready for development ahead of each sprint.
Answer developers’ questions promptly and align requirement interpretation with Tech Leads and R&D.
Review demos and builds against acceptance criteria and report deviations early.
Support QC by reviewing test cases against requirements and clarifying expected behavior.
4. Change Management & Traceability
Manage requirement changes: assess impact on scope, timeline, and dependencies, and escalate to Product Owner/PMO for decision.
Maintain requirement documentation and end-to-end traceability (requirement → story → test case → result).
Keep one consistent requirement baseline shared across Development, QC, Deployment, and PMO.
5. UAT, Deployment Support & Field Feedback
Support UAT, onsite testing, commissioning, and customer acceptance when requirement or product expertise is needed.
Analyze customer and field feedback; classify into defects, requirement gaps, AI limitations, and deployment issues; convert them into backlog items with clear acceptance criteria.
Recommend priorities to the Product Owner and confirm re-validation after fixes.
6. Cross-functional Collaboration
Partner with Market Development on customer discovery; Market Development owns opportunity and customer relationship, Product Owner owns priority and release decisions, Senior BA owns requirement clarity and quality.
Partner closely with Tech Leads and developers on feasibility and trade-offs; Tech Lead owns HOW (architecture and technical solution).
Align QC, Deployment, Robot Operations, and PMO around the same requirement baseline.
requirements:
Relevant Education & Experience
Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, AI, Robotics, Mechatronics, Automation, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related fields.
4+ years of experience
as a Business Analyst, Technical BA, or System Analyst, including 2+ years on systems with complex integration (hardware–software, IoT, AI, or cloud platforms).
Proven experience working daily with developers in Agile/Scrum teams: backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint review, and requirement clarification during the sprint.
Ability to write clear user stories, use cases, workflows, functional and non-functional requirements, and measurable acceptance criteria (e.g., Given-When-Then).
Skilled in process and system modeling (BPMN/UML, sequence and state diagrams) and in specifying API/integration, data flows, error handling, and edge cases.
Hands-on with Jira, Confluence (or equivalent tools); able to read logs and write basic SQL. Good English: able to read and write technical documentation and communicate with international stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications
Understanding of humanoid robotics, hardware–software integration, ROS/ROS2 concepts, AI Vision/VLM, LLM/Agentic AI, Conversational AI, or Human-Robot Interaction.
Familiarity with edge/cloud architecture, logging, monitoring, configuration, or release management.
Experience supporting UAT or deployment of robotics or AI systems in real-world environments, and defining evaluation criteria for AI features.
Awareness of robot safety requirements and how to express them as non-functional requirements.
Personality / Attitude
Strong ownership of requirement quality; analytical, system thinking, and data-driven.
Comfortable challenging unclear requirements and technical assumptions constructively; communicates clearly with both business and engineering.
Customer-oriented, collaborative, and effective in a fast-paced technology environment.
benefits:
Attractive income, competitive and commensurate with individual capabilities.
13th-month salary, gifts on public holidays and special occasions, and performance-based bonuses.
Meal allowance, annual company trips, health insurance, and exclusive benefits within the Group’s ecosystem
Clear career development opportunities aligned with the company’s growth, with access to training programs based on capability and job role.
A dynamic and open working environment with diverse cultural and sports activities.

title: Senior Business Analyst (Bank/Fintech)
description:
ITviec's client are looking for an experienced and strategic Senior Business Analyst to support strategic initiatives within one of Asia's leading digital banks.
The role will focus on understanding and documenting transaction flows, reconciliation processes, and system interactions across the bank's payments ecosystem, including the FIS platform.
The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, operations teams, engineers, architects, and vendors to analyze business processes, investigate data flows, support reconciliation-related initiatives, and contribute to migration and transformation programs.
This is a hands-on role requiring a combination of business analysis, technical investigation, and data analysis skills. The ideal candidate should be comfortable navigating databases, reviewing application behavior, analyzing transaction data, and translating technical findings into clear business requirements and process documentation.
Key Responsibilities
Business & Process Analysis
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and operational processes.
Understand and document end-to-end transaction and reconciliation flows.
Analyze existing processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
Facilitate discussions between business and technology stakeholders.
Produce business requirements, functional specifications, process maps, and supporting documentation.
Reconciliation & Data Analysis
Analyze transaction and reconciliation data across multiple systems.
Investigate reconciliation breaks, exceptions, and data discrepancies.
Perform root cause analysis and work with technical teams to identify resolutions.
Validate data consistency across source systems and interfaces.
Support operational and regulatory reporting requirements.
System & Technical Analysis
Develop a deep understanding of application behavior, integrations, and data flows.
Analyze APIs, database structures, interfaces, and system interactions.
Reverse engineer business processes from existing systems where documentation is incomplete.
Support impact assessments and solution design discussions.
Migration & Transformation Support
Support data migration and platform transformation initiatives.
Analyze source and target system mappings.
Define data validation and reconciliation requirements for migration activities.
Support testing, validation, and business sign-off activities.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with product owners, business users, engineers, architects, and vendors.
Translate technical concepts into business-friendly language.
Present findings, recommendations, and analysis outcomes to stakeholders.
requirements:
Required Skills & Experience
Must Have
5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst.
Strong understanding of system integration and data flows.
Hands-on experience working with SQL and databases.
Experience analyzing complex business processes and system interactions.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Experience working closely with engineering and delivery teams.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to operate independently in complex environments.
Preferred
Experience in banking or financial services.
Experience in payments, transaction processing, reconciliation, settlements, or core banking.
Experience supporting migration or transformation programs.
Working knowledge of Python or other scripting languages for data analysis.
Exposure to APIs, microservices, and cloud-based systems.
Experience performing data validation and reconciliation activities.
benefits:
Our client
is a prominent European-based technology consultancy with over 30 years of global expertise in digital transformation. They specialize in engineering next-generation core systems and high-scale data solutions for industry leaders within the Financial Services, Insurance, and Manufacturing sectors. Operating a robust network across more than 20 countries, the firm is at the forefront of integrating advanced automation and modern engineering workflows into the software development lifecycle. With a strong commitment to technical excellence and a distributed global delivery model, they offer senior experts the chance to lead complex modernization initiatives. This is an ideal environment for those looking to influence the future of digital banking and large-scale enterprise architecture.

Là công ty tiên phong ứng dụng công nghệ, ứng viên được đào tạo, cung cấp các công cụ AI và kỳ vọng ứng dụng tốt AI vào công việc, nâng cao chất lượng và hiệu quả công việc.
Trách nhiệm chính
Thiết kế & Phát triển phần mềm
Làm việc sát với bộ phận nghiệp vụ, mô hình hóa yêu cầu sản phẩm để đưa ra giải pháp thiết kế tối ưu, an toàn, có khả năng mở rộng cao.
Xây dựng và cập nhật tài liệu kỹ thuật, đặc tả API hay thiết kế dữ liệu.
Phát triển các hệ thống liên quan đến tài sản mã hóa và blockchain như tokenization platform, hệ thống custody, hệ thống sàn giao dịch tài sản mã hóa.
Tham gia review kiến trúc và source code trong nhóm của mình và cả bộ phận công nghệ.
Kiểm thử & Đảm bảo chất lượng
Xây dựng kịch bản kiểm thử (test-case), phát triển kiểm thử tự động và thực hiện kiểm thử tích hợp/chức năng cho hệ thống phần mềm.
Đảm bảo chất lượng đầu ra cho sản phẩm, giám sat và xử lý lỗi phần mềm (nếu có) trong quá trình khách hàng sử dụng.
Ứng dụng AI trong phát triển phần mềm
Trang bị kiến thức và kỹ năng sử dụng hiệu quả các công cụ AI cho việc phát triển phần mềm.
Xây dựng và tinh chỉnh các AI workflow phù hợp với công việc của mình, mở rộng tới việc chia sẻ cho cả nhóm cũng như cả bộ phận công nghệ và tới toàn bộ công ty.
Hợp tác & Vận hành
Chủ động đảm bảo tiến độ công việc cá nhân và dự án mình tham gia.
Phối hợp với đội vận hành khi triển khai, theo dõi và xử lý sự cố liên quan.
Chủ động tìm hiểu công nghệ mới và đề xuất chiến lược áp dụng vào sản phẩm.
requirements:
Học vấn & Kinh nghiệm
Tốt nghiệp Đại học các ngành Khoa học Máy tính, Kỹ thuật Phần mềm, Công nghệ Thông tin hoặc tương đương.
Đã có kinh nghiệm làm sản phẩm thực tế liên quan đến blockchain; là một lợi thế nếu từng làm hệ thống có nhiều người sử dụng, chứng minh được sự an toàn, ổn định
.
Kiến thức & Kỹ năng kỹ thuật
Nắm chắc kiến thức nền tảng CNTT: cấu trúc dữ liệu & giải thuật, mạng máy tính, hệ điều hành, cơ sở dữ liệu. Nắm vững Object Oriented Programming (OOP) và các nguyên tắc SOLID.
Nắm chắc kiến thức mật mã và xây dựng kiến trúc đảm bảo an toàn thông tin.
Hiểu sâu về nguyên lý hoạt động của blockchain nói chung, đã từng làm việc ở vị trí senior/lead/expert để xây dựng các hệ thống liên quan đến blockchain như launchpad, decentralized app, hệ thống custody.
Ưu tiên các ứng viên có kinh nghiệm làm việc, tích hợp với các thiết bị chuyên dụng như HSM.
Thành thạo ít nhất một ngôn ngữ lập trình và sẵn sàng học ngôn ngữ, công nghệ mới khi công việc cần.
Từng làm việc với cơ sở dữ liệu quan hệ (Oracle, MS SQL, PostgreSQL...) và các hệ lưu trữ/message queue như Redis, RabbitMQ; hiểu cách thiết kế API và kiến trúc microservices.
Có kinh nghiệm với các framework kiểm thử như JUnit, JMeter.
Kiến thức & Kỹ năng ứng dụng AI
Dùng thành thạo các công cụ AI trong việc phát triển phần mềm và nâng cao hiệu suất công việc.
Có khả năng xây dựng được AI workflow để thực hiện một phần hoặc toàn bộ quá trình phát triển phần mềm và vận hành hệ thống.
Kỹ năng & Tinh thần làm việc
Có tinh thần ham học hỏi và chủ động trong công việc.
Có trách nhiệm với công việc của mình, tự quản lý tốt và kỹ năng làm việc nhóm hiệu quả.
Có hứng thú tìm hiểu về kiến thức tài chính, đầu tư.
Điểm cộng
Đã có sản phẩm nhiều người dùng thực tế trên thị trường
benefits:

Trực tiếp xây dựng các hệ thống nền tảng tài chính có độ phức tạp và yêu cầu mở rộng cao.
Được đào tạo và trang bị đầy đủ công cụ AI phục vụ cho công việc phát triển phần mềm.
Được bổ sung kiến thức tài chính, đầu tư, hiểu rõ mục tiêu và giá trị mang lại của sản phẩm mình làm.

title: Senior Full-stack Engineer (.NET + Typescript)
description:

Senior Full-stack Engineer (.NET + Typescript)

You design and build the services behind our reconciliation engine – ingesting and normalising settlement files from banks and payment providers and matching them against our transaction data

You review code and help set the engineering standard for a new team

Performance optimization and accessibility in data-heavy web applications
Solid testing practice: unit and integration tests in .NET, Jest and Playwright on the front-end
Git and collaborative workflows: pull requests and code reviews
Clear written and spoken English for working with colleagues in Germany
Nice To Have
Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and basic knowledge of Kubernetes and Helm
Experience with Banking/Financial solution

Competitive salary and beneﬁts
Year-end bonus (13th-month salary)
Generous annual leave of up to 18 days
Additional premium health insurance
Enjoy an endless selection of delicious refreshments, including gourmet coffee, beverages, snacks, and fresh fruits, all complimentary
